summary: Lunar regolith adhesion poses a critical hazard to lunar exploration, as electrostatic charges bond dust particles aggressively to astronaut helmet visors. Traditional mechanical wiping causes irreversible micro-scratches, compromising visibility and safety. Astro-Visor is an innovative, non-contact mitigation system integrated into the outer visor frame. By utilizing targeted resonant-frequency micro-vibrations, it safely breaks the electrostatic bond within seconds without abrasive scraping. Key engineering innovations include ultra-low power consumption (using less than 3% of suit power), complete mechanical isolation via space-grade damping gaskets to protect the main helmet structure and astronaut, and a closed-loop smart control system using micro-accelerometers to ensure real-time safety thresholds. Astro-Visor delivers a lightweight, fail-safe, and energy-efficient solution ensuring pristine visibility for future lunar surface missions.
